noticeIntro: WT Content Manager is an unofficial, independent personal project in active development.
noticeAffiliation: It is not affiliated with, endorsed, sponsored, or approved by Gaijin Entertainment or War Thunder. War Thunder and related marks belong to their respective owners.
noticePrivacy: You do not need a Gaijin account, and your settings are not sent to a project server. Favorites, the game folder, and Home preferences are stored on this device. Diagnostic logs are local, enabled by default, and can be disabled in Settings. Online features contact external services, which receive ordinary connection data such as your IP address.
noticeRisk: Skins are third-party files. When extracting ZIP archives, only supported files are kept (.blk, .dds, .tga, .png, .jpg/.jpeg, .csv, .txt, and .md); executables and other file types are skipped. The app does not scan files for malware; install them at your discretion.
noticeDevelopment: This release supports Windows and focuses on camouflage management. Sound support and other modules are planned for later; Linux support is only a possibility being explored.
